title: Sukha Singh turns on the intruders and the Singhs cross the river

blocks.text: Sukha Singh then warned that the Singhs would have to kill the people for their own survival if they wished to remain alive in the jungle. Once the Khalsa rushed at the armed intruders, the Jat intruders started fleeing, leaving horses, garments, and weapons behind as they scattered.

That reprieve gave the survivors a moment to regroup and head for the Majha region rather than remain trapped in the same killing ground. They forced a rapid march through hostile country and then faced yet another river barrier on the road to safety.

To cross it, the Singhs had to make-shift boats of reeds and grass and trust the current once more. After landing, they endured stretches of burning sand so fierce that many tore off their dresses to make footpads, turning even their clothing into part of the struggle to survive.
